πέσωσι: πίπτω — fall; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., epic -σι (= Attic πέσωσιν)
παλίωξιν: παλίωξις — chase back, driving back in pursuit (rare; exact sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg.
παρασταδόν: παρασταδόν — standing beside, at close quarters; adv. (from παρίστημι)
παυσάμενον: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); aor. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’having ceased’
παύω: παύω — stop, make cease; pres. 1 sg. act. (indic.): ’I stop’

τεύχοιμι: τεύχω — make, bring about; pres. opt. 1 sg. act.: ’I would make’
χλωροὶ: χλωρός — pale, greenish; masc. nom. pl.

__broaden__.γούνων: γόνυ — knee; neut. gen. pl., epic γούνων (= Attic γονάτων); gen. of the part grasped, after λαβέ · also neut. gen. pl., with λίσσομαι ’beseech’: ’at the knees’ · also neut. gen. pl., gen. of the part touched, after ἅπτομαι: ’took hold of the knees’
__broaden__.δεσμὸν: δεσμός — bond, fetter, tether; masc. acc. sg., object of ἀπορρήξας · also masc. acc. sg., object of ἴηλα: ’cast a bond’
__broaden__.εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (εἰς Ἄϊδος ’to Hades’) · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ … ἕλοιεν ’until they should take’)
__broaden__.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’ · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’
__broaden__.κουρίδιον: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a spouse); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with λέχος: ’wedded’
__broaden__.κόων: Κόων — Coön, son of Antenor; masc. nom. sg., proper name · also Κῶς — Cos, an island; acc. sg. Κόων with the suffix -δε: ’to Cos’ (Κόων δ’)
__broaden__.μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’)
__broaden__.νεφέλῃσιν: νεφέλη — cloud; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), dative of likeness after ἐοικότες · also fem. dat. pl., after ἐν: ’in the clouds’
__broaden__.νοήσῃ: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή (fear): ’lest she notice’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., in a condition after εἰ: ’if he notices’ (εἴ πέρ τε νοήσῃ) · also aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause: ’whoever thinks of’ (ὅς τ’ … νοήσῃ)
__broaden__.ποδοῖιν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. dual, epic -οῖιν (= Attic ποσίν): ’with her two feet’ · also dual gen., after ἐκ: ’from the feet’
__broaden__.τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
__broaden__.ἀνάλκιδα: ἄναλκις — without strength, unwarlike, cowardly; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with σε: ’a coward’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἐμέ: ’(me) without might’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with φύζαν: ’(panic) without might’
__broaden__.ἀργαλέῳ: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄσθματι: ’grievous (gasping)’
__broaden__.ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with κάρητι: ’my own’
__broaden__.ἔλθῃ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’until … comes’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα (purpose): ’that she may go’
__broaden__.ἔχετ: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. cling, hold on; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἔχετ’ = ἔχετο): ’kept holding on’ · also impf. 3 sg. mid./pass., of being gripped by an affliction (dat.): ’was held, gripped’ (ἀργαλέῳ … ἄσθματι ’by grievous gasping’)
__broaden__.ἕλοιεν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. opt. 3 pl. act.: ’might take’, in a fear clause after μή · also aor. opt. 3 pl., after εἰς ὅ κ’: ’until … should take’
__broaden__.ἡρακλῆος: Ἡρακλῆς — Heracles; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έους), after περιχώσατο: ’at Heracles’ · also masc. gen. sg., objective gen. with ὀδύνη: ’pain for Heracles’
